parameters.command:
#!/bin/bash

# --- VARIABLES ---
# N8N-injected variable from the previous Code node
BRANCH_NAME="{{ $json.branch_name }}"
# --- MUST BE UPDATED ---
PROJECT_DIR="/var/www/drupal/ci_builds/{{ $json.branch_name }}" 
REPO_URL="git@github.com:your-org/your-repo.git" 
# -------------------------

# --- CORE DRUPAL CI/CD PROCESS ---

echo "Starting CI/CD process for branch: $BRANCH_NAME"

# 1. Setup/Update Environment (Clone if first time, or pull if already exists)
if [ ! -d "$PROJECT_DIR" ]; then
    echo "Cloning repository..."
    mkdir -p "$PROJECT_DIR"
    # Use --depth 1 for faster cloning if history is not needed
    git clone $REPO_URL "$PROJECT_DIR" || { echo "Git clone failed"; exit 1; }
fi

cd "$PROJECT_DIR" || { echo "Error: Failed to change directory to $PROJECT_DIR"; exit 1; }

# Checkout the specific branch and pull latest changes
git fetch origin
git checkout $BRANCH_NAME || { echo "Git checkout failed"; exit 1; }
git pull origin $BRANCH_NAME || { echo "Git pull failed"; exit 1; }

# 2. Dependency Management
echo "Running Composer install..."
composer install --no-interaction --prefer-dist --optimize-autoloader || { echo "Composer failed"; exit 1; }

# 3. Drupal Operations (Config & DB)
# Note: Ensure your environment has the correct database settings
DRUSH_PATH="./vendor/bin/drush"

echo "Running Drush commands (config and updates)..."
# Clear cache first
$DRUSH_PATH cr || { echo "Drush CR failed"; exit 1; }
# Import configuration (essential for changes to take effect)
$DRUSH_PATH cim -y || { echo "Drush CIM failed"; exit 1; }
# Run database updates
$DRUSH_PATH updb -y || { echo "Drush UPDB failed"; exit 1; }
# Clear cache again
$DRUSH_PATH cr || { echo "Drush CR failed"; exit 1; }

# 4. Automated Testing (Customize this to your specific test suite)
echo "Running PHPUnit tests..."
# Example command - adjust the path/command to your test suite
./vendor/bin/phpunit -c web/core/phpunit.xml.dist modules/custom/your_module || { echo "PHPUnit tests failed!"; exit 1; }

echo "CI/CD Build and Test successful for branch $BRANCH_NAME"
# Success exit code
exit 0
